hero.paragraph: Business moves with purpose. Your travel should move with the same precision — a premium corporate travel house for executives, leadership teams, and organizations operating across borders.

standard.heading: Six principles. One distinctive way of travel.
standard.intro: The Six Standard is more than a service philosophy. It is the discipline behind every journey we deliver.

principles.title: Anticipation
principles.line: We move before you have to.
principles.body: Exceptional travel begins before departure. We anticipate changing schedules, evolving priorities, and connection points — because the finest service isn't reactive. It's already there when you need it.

principles.title: Simplicity
principles.body: Global business travel can involve countless moving parts — multiple travelers, multiple destinations, demanding schedules. We bring them together with clarity. Behind the scenes, we coordinate everything. In front of you, it feels effortless.

principles.title: Elevation
principles.line: Ordinary will never be the standard.
principles.body: Every element of the journey is selected with intention — the right flight, the right address, the right vehicle. We don't add luxury for the sake of appearance. We elevate what matters.

principles.title: Connection
principles.body: A journey is only as seamless as the connections between its parts — air, accommodation, ground transportation, events, people. SIX brings them together as one continuous experience. Nothing fragmented. Nothing overlooked.

principles.title: Protection
principles.line: Your time deserves to be protected.
principles.body: Time is the one business asset that cannot be recovered. We eliminate unnecessary coordination and manage the details that compete for your attention — so you can arrive focused, and leave with your time intact.

principles.title: Execution
principles.body: A promise means little without execution. SIX TRAVEL operates with precision, accountability, and attention to detail at every stage of the journey — from the first itinerary to the final arrival.
